faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I need WhatsApp Business API?
faq.a1: Yes, but you don't need to set it up yourself. Our concierge team handles the entire WABA registration and Meta Business Manager verification as part of the one-time template license fee.
faq.q2: Can I use my existing phone number?
faq.a2: In most cases, yes. If your number isn't currently on WhatsApp Business API, we can migrate it. If it's on a personal WhatsApp account, we'll walk you through the migration process during onboarding.
faq.a3: Most agents are fully live within 3–5 business days. The onboarding session takes about 45–60 minutes, and we handle the rest behind the scenes.
faq.q4: Does it work with leads from ShowcaseIDX or my website?
faq.a4: Yes. Leads from ShowcaseIDX, your website, landing pages, or any source that triggers a WhatsApp message or web form submission will feed into the system. We configure the connections during setup.
faq.a5: No. WhachatCRM does not add any markup to messages. WhatsApp messaging fees are billed directly by Meta at their standard rates.
faq.a6: Absolutely. The Pro plan includes unlimited users. You can assign leads, share notes, and collaborate from a single unified inbox.

commerceEducation.intro: Help shoppers choose products, recover eligible abandoned checkouts and keep customers informed after purchase. This guide is for Shopify merchants using WhachatCRM. Start with the features your business needs; installing the app does not enable customer messages.

sections.title: Your Shopify growth tools
paragraphs: AI Shopping answers product questions and recommends products. Checkout Recovery reconnects with eligible shoppers. Post-Purchase keeps customers informed through approved WhatsApp messages.
Your Shopify catalog, customer purchase records, Unified Inbox, AI Brain and Follow-ups are shared with the rest of WhachatCRM. You do not need a second catalog or another onboarding wizard.

sections.title: Getting started
paragraphs: 1. Open Settings in the engine, connect Shopify and complete the Shopify approval screen. Return to WhachatCRM and confirm that the store is connected.

2. Open activation and setup. Activate the engine after your Shopify connection and eligible Pro plan or trial are verified. If your plan is ineligible, use Review plan. Engine activation alone does not start messages.
3. Connect your WhatsApp Business account in Settings → Channels. Use the business number you want customers to contact and complete the requested permissions.
4. In AI Shopping, enable the assistant, choose connected channels, set the recommendation limit and human handoff preference, then Save. Review business knowledge in AI Brain.

5. In Cart Recovery or Post-Purchase, choose the customer consent purposes, business name and notice language. Save changes before adding the notices to Shopify. Use Set up in Shopify, enable the consent section and save the published theme, or place the supplied notices and opt-in links on the store page you specified.

6. Choose Set up my messages to reuse compatible approved templates or submit missing English templates for Meta review. Review or customize messages in WhatsApp Library; select a compatible approved message for each journey. The interface language does not change a message template’s language.

7. Select the post-purchase journeys you need and enable them. Enable checkout reminders separately. If activation is blocked, follow the reason shown beside that journey. Approval of a template or saving consent settings alone does not enable sending.
8. Return to the engine to review current activity, template approval and message results. Refresh template status when needed. Saved settings are loaded again when you revisit or refresh.

sections.title: AI Shopping Assistant
paragraphs: The assistant uses synced Shopify products, variants, prices and available inventory to answer questions and recommend suitable products. Review the Shopify products page if an item or price looks wrong; check the connection and catalog sync before trying again.

Add store policies, delivery information and FAQs in AI Brain. Keep this business knowledge accurate; product data does not replace your policies. Enable only the connected channels you want: website chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, SMS or Telegram. Selecting a channel does not connect it.

Choose the maximum number of recommendations and enable human handoff when the assistant cannot help. Continue customer conversations in the Unified Inbox. Save changes and check the confirmation before leaving.

Checkout assistance has its own availability check. If it is unavailable, product questions and recommendations can still work. Do not assume the assistant can create carts, complete payments or change orders. If answers are incomplete, check synced products, AI Brain knowledge, selected channels and your plan.

sections.title: Cart and checkout recovery
paragraphs: Recovery sends an approved WhatsApp reminder for an eligible abandoned checkout, helping shoppers return to their purchase. A detected checkout is an observation, not a sent reminder or a recovered sale.

Current recovery checks start after the existing 60-minute eligibility delay and require a checkout observed after activation. This is not a guarantee of sending at exactly 60 minutes. Completed purchases, missing purpose-specific consent, opt-outs, contact restrictions or unavailable templates can prevent sending.

Open Cart Recovery, save consent collection, select an approved checkout reminder and choose Enable checkout reminders when ready. Pause checkout reminders to stop further sending. Review detected checkout counts and messaging activity; these counts do not prove delivery or revenue.

sections.title: Post-purchase assistance
paragraphs: Supported order messages include order confirmations, shipping/fulfillment updates and order cancellations. Choose only the supported purposes you need, assign approved WhatsApp templates and enable selected post-purchase journeys.

Customers need permission for each message purpose. An order or shipping event alone is not permission. Events before activation are not sent retrospectively. Other offers or follow-ups shown in your account remain subject to their own availability and setup; do not assume every order update is automated.

Use Pause post-purchase journeys before changing a live message selection. Review the selected message and status, then enable again when ready. A template awaiting approval, paused or rejected by Meta cannot be used for sending.

sections.title: Consent and WhatsApp requirements

steps.title: Connect WhatsApp Business
steps.instruction: Open Settings → Channels, choose Connect for WhatsApp and complete the requested connection and permissions using your business number.
steps.success: Your business number shows as connected in Channels. If it does not, finish or renew the connection.

steps.title: Set up consent in Shopify
steps.instruction: In Cart Recovery or Post-Purchase, choose the consent purposes, business name and notice language, then Save changes. Choose Set up in Shopify, enable the consent section and save the published theme. If your theme is unsupported, place the supplied notice and opt-in link on the Shopify page you specified.
steps.success: The notices are saved. Return from Shopify and check for Live on store; if verification is unavailable, follow the displayed setup instructions. Theme setup does not prove any customer has consented.

steps.title: Choose approved templates
steps.instruction: Choose Set up my messages. Review approval, language and purpose in WhatsApp Library, then select a compatible approved message for each journey. Missing templates are currently submitted in English; interface language does not translate customer messages.
steps.success: The selected message is approved and assigned to the journey. If Meta review is pending, wait and use Refresh template status. Approval alone does not start sending.

steps.title: Activate the features you need
steps.instruction: Select your post-purchase purposes and choose Enable selected post-purchase journeys. Enable checkout reminders separately in Cart Recovery. Follow any missing-setup reason beside the control.
steps.success: The journey shows Active. Each customer still needs permission for that purpose and must qualify. Use the corresponding Pause action to stop further sending.

notes: Customers choose each purpose freely. Display the saved notice and opt-in link in Shopify. The customer must send the exact WhatsApp text shown with that purpose from their own number. Clicking a link, saving a merchant setting or checking a Shopify email/SMS box does not grant WhatsApp permission.

Customers can send STOP to opt out. Missing consent, opt-outs, contact restrictions, a changed connection or a completed purchase can make a message ineligible. Never send an unsolicited WhatsApp message to ask for permission.

sections.title: Understand your results

statuses.label: Active
statuses.description: The feature is enabled. Each customer and message still needs to qualify.

statuses.label: Ready to activate
statuses.description: Required setup is verified. You must still enable the journey.

statuses.label: Needs setup
statuses.description: Complete the displayed connection, consent or template step.

statuses.label: Unavailable
statuses.description: The feature cannot be used under the current conditions.

statuses.label: Coming soon
statuses.description: The feature is not released yet.

statuses.label: Queued
statuses.description: The message is waiting to be processed.

statuses.label: Accepted by Meta
statuses.description: Meta accepted the request. This does not confirm delivery to the customer.

statuses.label: Delivered
statuses.description: A delivery receipt confirms the message reached the customer.

statuses.label: Read
statuses.description: A read receipt confirms opening, when available.

statuses.label: Failed
statuses.description: The attempt did not complete successfully.

statuses.label: Needs review
statuses.description: The outcome is uncertain. Acceptance or delivery is not confirmed.

statuses.label: Suppressed or ineligible
statuses.description: A required condition was not met, so sending was skipped.

notes: Activated, queued and accepted do not mean delivered. The current summary groups delivered and read together. Suppressed or ineligible messages may not appear in the aggregate counters.

items.question: Why can’t I activate a feature?
items.answer: Check Shopify connection, eligible plan/trial, WhatsApp connection, saved consent purposes and approved message selection. Follow the specific reason next to the control; contact support if availability still blocks setup.

items.question: Why isn’t WhatsApp connected?
items.answer: Open Settings → Channels, finish the connection and permissions, or renew the existing connection. Return and refresh template status.

items.question: Why is my template missing?
items.answer: Review its approval, language and category in WhatsApp Library. Only compatible approved messages appear. Meta review may take time; use Refresh template status. Pause the journey before changing its selected message.

items.question: Why didn’t a customer receive an order confirmation?
items.answer: Confirm the journey was active before the order, its purpose was selected, the template is approved and the customer gave that specific permission. Check whether the message is queued, accepted, failed or needs review. Accepted alone is not delivery.

items.question: Why wasn’t a checkout reminder sent?
items.answer: A detected checkout must still meet the delay, consent and eligibility checks. A completed purchase or opt-out prevents reminders. Check the journey status and selected checkout template.

items.question: How do I update AI knowledge?
items.answer: Open AI Brain and review your store policies, FAQs and business information. Review Shopify products separately for catalog issues.

items.question: How do I pause automation?
items.answer: Use Pause checkout reminders or Pause post-purchase journeys. To stop AI Shopping, clear its enable option and Save. Pausing does not recall messages already accepted by the provider.

items.question: Why aren’t settings saving?
items.answer: Look for an error or unsaved changes, complete required fields and check your connection. Retry Save and wait for confirmation. Reopen the page to verify before enabling journeys; keep a copy of unsaved text before refreshing.

items.question: How do I reconnect Shopify?
items.answer: Open the engine Settings or Integrations → Shopify and complete the existing connect flow. Review consent, templates and activation again after reconnecting.

items.question: Where can I get help?
items.answer: Open Help from the app navigation. Include the affected feature, displayed status and time of the issue; do not include customer message contents or credentials.
